givebutter_mcp_url.title: Givebutter MCP server URL
givebutter_mcp_url.description: The /mcp endpoint of your deployed givebutter-mcp Cloudflare Worker, e.g. https://givebutter-mcp.<subdomain>.workers.dev/mcp. Leave blank to skip the Givebutter integration.

givebutter_mcp_token.title: Givebutter MCP access token
givebutter_mcp_token.description: The shared bearer token (MCP_AUTH_TOKEN) configured on the Worker. Leave blank if the Worker has no MCP_AUTH_TOKEN set.
